abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.text: When you make a ranged attack and do not move during your turn, you increase the Salvo of your weapons by +Rank. In addition, when you wield a pair of Auto Boltstorm Gauntlets or Flamestorm Gauntlets, you may benefit from the Dual Wield or Simultaneous Strike talents even though those weapons lack the Pistol trait. Standing still, the Hellstorm Bolt Rifle's Salvo is 3. The launcher and grenades have Salvo –, so it does nothing for them; he carries no gauntlets.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you ignore any impurities in your Chapter Gene-Seed, and also gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Siege Masters
abilities.text: You may reroll Double Rank dice once per attack against a building, fortification, or enemy in cover. You may also add +Rank bonus dice whenever you make a Test related to architectural engineering. Against a wall or bulkhead he is breaching, and against Kommandos in cover.

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Killer Instinct (+1 Max Wounds); Accomplishment Crusader (+1 Determination: sworn against Orks); Goal Vengeance (+1 Determination). Determination is 8 (T 6 + 2).

talents.name: Legacy of the Primarch
talents.text: [IMPERIAL FISTS]: Once per game session, you may draw on your knowledge of siege warfare to reduce by (Rank) either the DN of a Test made to attack a building, fortification, or enemy in cover, or the DN of a Test related to architectural engineering.

talents.name: Pain Glove Endurant
talents.text: You ignore penalties to Tests caused by pain. In addition, you are immune to Fear.

weapons.name: Grenade Launcher (Frag)
traits: Fires one of his Frag Grenades

weapons.name: Grenade Launcher (Krak)
traits: Fires one of his Krak Grenades

gear: Astartes Grenade Launcher (VoA p.67): Range 12/24/36, Assault; fires his Frag or Krak Grenades (VoA p.64)
Ammo Backpack (Core p.229): carry 10 additional Ammo; it came stocked with 3
Ballistic Appeasement Auto-Reliquary (Core p.236): clear a jammed weapon as a Free Action
Dragonfire Bolt rounds (Spread; ignores Defence bonuses from cover, Core p.230; BOLT weapons only)

detail.personality: A patient, immovable son of Dorn who treats every breach as a siege to be won. He keeps a tally of Ork skulls etched on his bolt rifle's casing, and gets quietly annoyed whenever someone suggests falling back.

objectives.text: Chapter: hold a position against the horde without falling back.
Secret: take 5 Ork skulls for your bolter's tally.
